He was wandering around the village, in the guise of a seamstress, listening to the words of the people, he saw a glorious woman in a village and took her to the city, and made as a queen named Ubbarī. (B) King Cūḷanī Brahmadatta who ruled Pañcāla in Kapila Division. He was the son of King Mahācūḷanī and Queen Salāka Devī. When he was a child, he fled to Sāgara, Madda division due to the danger of his uncle, Chabbhi Brahmin. Then, he got married to the daughter of King Madda, Princes Nandā. When his uncle Chabbhi Brahmin died, he went back to Uttara pañcāla in Kapila Division and became king.

cūḷaniddesa: [Cūḷa+niddesa] (pu) CL=10 Cūḷaniddesa Pāli Canon; This Cūḷaniddesa is the Pali text taught by Ashin Sariputtara, the Dhammasenāpati, by distinguishing between the meaning of the Parāyana-vagga and the Khaggavisāna Sutta taught by the Buddha in the Sutta Nipāta. It is counted in Sutta Pīṭaka of the three Piṭakas. In the five Nikayas, it is included in the Khuddaka Nikāya. in the Choddaka Nikaya. Among the nine elements of Sutta, geyya, veyyākaraṇa, gāthā, udāna, itivuttaka, jātaka, abbutadhamma, vedalla; Ashin Mahābuddhaghosa Thera and Ashin Dhammapala Thera counted in the Sutta group. Ashin Upasena Thera, the compiler of the Mahāniddesa Aṭṭakathā and the Cūḷaniddesa Aṭṭakathā, is regarded as in the two:  Gāthā and Veyyākaraṇā.

cūḷantaraduka: [Cūḷa+antaraduka] (pu,na) CL=10 Cūḷantra-dyad. It is called Cūḷantra-duka because it is placed between the Gocchaka (a cluster group) and because it is smaller than the Mahantra duka. A sutta was preached that at the night of a full moon day, while the Blessed One was dwelling at the Pubbārāma in Sāvatthi, and He taught the characteristics of the evil and the good and their destiny to the monks who were sitting silent around Him.
cūḷapāsāda: [Cūḷa+pāsāda] (pu) CL=10 Small mansion; A small terrace.
cūḷaratha: [Cūḷa+ratha] (pu) CL=10 A person named Cūḷaratha; A deity named Cūḷaratha. See- Cūḷarathadevaputta.
cūḷarathadevaputta: [Cūḷaratha+devaputta] (pu) CL=10 A deity named Cūḷaratha; Cūḷaratha deity.
cūḷarathavimāna: [Cūḷa+ratha+vimāna] (pu,na) CL=10 Cūḷarathavimāna vatthu. The story of a deity who is glorified by the 7-Yūjanā (miles) railway-mensions decorated with seven jewels in the Tāvatiṃsā realm due to good deeds such as charity and virtuous deeds performed by human life.
cūḷarāhulovādasutta: [Cūḷa+rāhulovāda+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷarāhulovāda Sutta. The Blessed One, realizing the maturity of the senses, instructed Ven. Rāhulā to become an Arahant, then asked and answered him: "The eye is permanent or impermanent," so on.
cūḷarāhulovādasuttapariyosāna: [Cūḷarāhulovādasutta+pariyesāna] (na) CL=10 The end of the Cūḷarāhulovāda Sutta.
cūḷasakkapañha: [Cūḷa+sakkapañha] (pu) CL=10 A small sutta that was asked by the king of deity (Sakka). (It is named Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaya).
cūḷasakuludāyisutta: [Cūḷa+sakuludāyi+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷasakuludāyī Sutta. The Lord Buddha taught to the wanderer Sakuludāyī about noble Dhamma.
cūḷasaññā: [Cūḷā+saññā] (thī) CL=10 The symbol of the hair knot.
cūḷaseṭṭhi: [Cūḷa+seṭṭhi] (pu) CL=10 A person named Cūḷaseṭṭhi (A) The Buddha to be, the rich Cūḷasetthi. (B) The rich Cūḷaseṭṭhi. (C) The ghost Cūḷaseṭṭhi. See-Cūḷseṭṭhipeta.
cūḷaseṭṭhijātaka: [Cūḷaseṭṭhi+jātaka] (na) CL=10 The story of Cūḷaseṭṭhi; A story about a Buddha to be, the rich man who said that he could become rich by trading with a dead mouse.
cūḷaseṭṭhipeta: [Cūḷaseṭṭhi+peta] (pu) CL=10 A ghost named Cūḷaseṭṭhi. See original.
cūḷasivatthera: [Cūḷa+siva+thera] (pu) CL=10 An Elder monk named Cūḷasiva.
cūḷasotāpanna: [Cūḷa+sotāpanna] (pu) CL=10 A minor stream-winner. (A) Adore and confidence with aspiring to the Triple gems. (B) Absence of disease. (C) Lacking deceitfulness. (D) Making an effort to develop wholesomely and prevent unwholesomely. (E) A Yogī who is endowed with the five faculties; knowing the arising and falling down of mind and matter; ability to destroy the attachment, and fulfillment of the knowledge on the arising and falling down,  is called "Cūḷa sotāpanna". See original.
cūḷasubhaddā: [Cūḷā+subhaddā] (thī) CL=10 A woman named Cūḷasubaddā. (A) Cūḷasubaddā, a daughter of the rich Anāthapiṇḍika. (B) Cūḷasubaddā, a former queen of Elephant King Chaddanta.
cūḷasubhaddāsamāgama: [Cūḷasubhaddā+samāgama] (pu) CL=10 Meeting group of Cūḷasubhadda. A Collective group that of the chief Cūḷasubhadda and followers, who attained the noble Dhamma.
cūḷasuddhanta: [Cūḷa+suddhanta] (pu) CL=10 Stayed isolated by the Vinaya rule called Cūḷasuddhanta. Cūḷasuddhanta parivāsa is called a rule that being put under restraint, for a certain monk who is aware of the period of purity from which the day is purified from a Saṃghādisesa offense.
cūḷasudhammatthera: [Cūḷa+sudhamma+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder monk named Cūḷasudhamma.
cūḷasumana: [Cūḷa+sumana] (pu) CL=10 A person named Cūḷasumana. (A) Cūḷasumana, a son of Mahāmuṇḍakī, from Muṇḍanigama village. (B) The rich Cūḷasumana. See-Cūḷasumanakuṭumpiya.
cūḷasumanatthera: [Cūḷasumana+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder named Cūḷasumana. (A) Cūḷasumana Thera who lives at the Mahāvihara monastery. (B) Cūḷasumana Thera who lives in the Rohaṇajanapada-village. (C) Cūḷasumana Thera who stays in Niṅgapoṇṇakapadhānaghara monastery at the Mount Cittala.
cūḷasutasoma: [Cūḷa+sutasoma] (pu) CL=10 A King named Cūḷasutasoma. See-Cūḷasutasomakāla.
cūḷasutasomajātaka: [Cūḷasutasoma+jātaka] (na) CL=10 The story of Cūḷasutasoma. A story said about the fulfillment of the perfection of renunciation while the Buddha to be was the King Cūḷasutasoma.
cūḷasutasomajātakāla: [Cūḷasutasoma+jāta+kāla] (pu) CL=10 By the time of King Cūḷasutasoma.
cūḷasutasomakāla: [Cūḷasutasoma+kāla] (pu) CL=10 At the time of King Cūḷasutasoma.
cūḷasutasomasamāgama: [Cūḷasutasoma+samāgama] (pu) CL=10 A group meeting of Cūḷasutasoma. Group of people, who came out for renunciation with the chief of the King Sutasoma.
cūḷasuvajātaka: [Cūḷa+suva+jātaka] (na) CL=10 The story of Cūḷasuva. The story shows that there is no fluctuation in food in the life of the Buddha to be, as a parrot king.
cūḷasuññatasutta: [Cūḷa+suññatā+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷasuññata Sutta. A discourse that preached about living in the state of emptiness, being absent from elephants, cows, horses, donkeys, gold, silver, etc.
cūḷasāropamasutta: [Cūḷasāropama+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷasāropama Sutta. A Sutta preached by giving an example of a person who seeks the essence of a tree and explained in detail to the bhikkhus who wish to seek the essence, such as acquisition looks like the branches, the virtu looks like outer bark, the bark of Jhāna, the shield of Abhiññāṇa, and the essence of Magga and Phala.
cūḷasīhanādasutta: [Cūḷasīhanāda+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷasīhanāda Sutta. A discourse preached as a lion roar that four kinds of bhikkhus; Sotāpanna, Sakadāgāmi, Anāgāmi, and Arahat, are the only ones in the teaching of the Buddha, and not in the other beliefs and practices.
cūḷasīhanādasuttavaṇṇanā: [Cūḷasīhanādasutta+vaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=10 The explanation of the Cūḷāsīhanāda Sutta; The words of explanation on the Cūḷāsīhanāda Sutta.
cūḷasīla: [Cūḷa+sīla] (na) CL=10 Cūḷa Sīla; Small Precepts; Slightly-summed virtuous deeds. (there are 26 virtuous deeds by abstinence from killing, etc., See-DN, 1. 3-5).
cūḷasīvatthera: [Cūḷa+sīva+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder monk named Cūḷāsīva. (A) Cūḷāsīva Thera, who lived in the Lokantara monastery. (B) Cūḷāsīva Thera, who memorized Majjhima Nikāya.
cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhayasutta: [Cūḷa+taṇhāsaṅkhaya+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaya Sutta. The Blessed One answered the questions of the deity king (Sakka), how does a monk become to be a person who absents lust, has the sense object to the Nibbhāna, certain all the complete person, who has overcoming of Yoga and Nibbāna, who really practices noble practices, and so on.
cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttisutta: [Cūḷa+taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti Sutta (It is also called Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaya Sutta).
cūḷatissatthera: [Cūḷa+tissa+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder monk named Cūḷatissa.
cūḷattika: [Cūḷa+tika] (pu) CL=10 Small triad. A collection of three smalls.
cūḷatāpasa: [Cūḷa+tāpasa] (pu) CL=10 Young hermit; The youth hermit.
cūḷavacchatthera: [Cūḷa+vaccha+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder monk named Cūḷavaccha.
cūḷavagga: [Cūḷa+vagga] (pu) CL=10 Small group; A small collection; A small chapter; A small group.
cūḷavaja: [Cūḷa+vaja] (pu) CL=10 Small cattle ranch. Small cattle farm.
cūḷavedallasutta: [Cūḷavedalla+sutta] (na) CL=10 Cūḷavedalla Sutta. It is the answered discourse by Dhammadinnā Bhikkhunī, the questions of Visākha laity (her old husband): such as "What is Sakkāya"? to till the Nibbāna.
cūḷaviyūhasuttaniddesa: [Cūḷaviyūhasutta+niddesa] (pu) CL=10 The words that are given in detail about Cūḷaviyūha Sutta. The explanation of Cūḷaviyūha Sutta. See-Cūḷabyūha suttaniddesa.
cūḷaṃsa: [Cūḷa+aṃsa] (pu) CL=10 A small side; Cross side (erect, upright).
cūḷaṅgaṇiyayuddha: [Cūḷa+aṅgaṇiya+yuddha] (pu) CL=10 War of Cūḷaṅgaṇiya; A battle to be fought in the place of Cūḷaṅgaṇiya.
cūḷaṅgulinakhapiṭṭhi: [Cūḷaṅguli+nakhapiṭṭhi] (thī) CL=10 Nail of a small finger; Fingernail of the pinkie.
cūḷekasāṭaka: [Cūḷa+ekasāṭaka] (pu) CL=10 Young Ekasāṭaka; A person named Cūḷekasāṭaka; A Brahmin named Cūḷekasāṭaka.
cūḷikā: [Cūḷa+ṇu+ā] (thī) CL=10 Cuda+ṇvu+ā. Cūḷanimajjane, ṇvu, cūḷikā. Cuda sañcodane vā, codenti ettha aṅkusādīhi adantanti cūḷikā, dassa ḷo, ṇvu. Dhān, ṭī. 363.]  Base; the base of ear (base of elephant ear).
cūḷā: [Cūḷa+a+ā] (thī) CL=10 Cūḷa sañcodane, cūḷahāvakaraṇe vā, a. Dhāna, ṭī. 258. Cu+ḷa+ā. Cavatīti cūḷā, sikhā. Ṇvādi, 225. Cuda+a+ā. Cula+a+ā. Ti, pi, Dhān.] (1) A crest of hair.  (2) Hair knot. (3) The crown. (4) The edge; the peak. See-Cūḷāmaṇi.  (5) (similar with horn) Rash; Knob.
cūḷābhaya: [Cūḷa+abhaya] (pu) CL=10 A person named Cūḷābhaya; An elder monk named Cūḷābhaya.
cūḷābhayatthera: [Cūḷābhaya+thera] (pu) CL=10 An elder monk named Cūḷābhaya; Young monk Abhaya.
cūḷākappanā: [Cūḷā+kappanā] (thī) CL=10 Repairing the hair knot. See-Cūḷakappanamaṅgala.
cūḷāmaṇi: [Cūḷā+maṇi] (pu) CL=10 (1) Ruby hairpins that are used in the hair knot; Hairpins made by ruby. (2) Ruby that put on the top of the white umbrella. White umbrella rubies. (3) Rubies on the top of the crown. (4) Unit of weight.
cūḷāmaṇibandhana: [Cūḷāmaṇi+bandhana] (na) CL=10 A hairstyle that knots by the ruby hairpin.
cūḷāmaṇicetiya: [Cūḷā+maṇi+cetiya] (na) CL=10 A pagoda that dedicates to the Buddha was buried together with the crown and hair; Cūḷāmaṇi Pagoda. See original.
cūḷāmaṇipuṭa: [Cūḷāmaṇi+puṭa] (pu) CL=10 A package of ruby hairpins; A bundle of ruby hairpins.
cūḷāmaṇiveṭhana: [Cūḷāmaṇi+veṭhana] (na) CL=10 A hair knot that knots by the ruby hairpin.
cūḷahasajātaka: [Cūḷa+haṃsajātaka] (na) CL=10 Cūḷahaṃsa Jātaka; A story about the Buddha to be, a king of a golden swan.
cūḷasa: [Cūḷa+aṃsa] (pu) CL=10 A small side; Cross side (erect, upright).
